t: This is the Australian War Memorial, on the southernmost corner of Hyde Park Corner, on the traffic island that also holds the Wellington Arch. It was dedicated in 2003 and remembers the 102,000 Australians who died in the First and Second World Wars. It was made by Janet Laurence, a Sydney artist who works in photography, sculpture, video and installation, and whose work is driven by concern for the environment and a wish to connect people with the natural world. Nearby on the same island are the New Zealand War Memorial, the Machine Gun Corps Memorial and the Royal Artillery Memorial.
